name: room-clock
title: Room Clock
description: A countdown to a host timestamp, in minutes and seconds ("7:42"), for the timers that run for minutes: a breakout, a round of pair talk. (`TimerRing` counts the seconds of a quiz round; a ring that says 600 is a poor way to say ten minutes.) The deadline…
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/room-clock

Installed to `components/ui/games/room-clock.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/games/room-clock';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/room-clock

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
